descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-24 Deletions · S21 「时间：删病人马上生效；删除之后的每次处理都记模型、AI 时间和总时间」 Timing: a patient delete takes effect at once; every processing run after deletes logs model, AI time and total

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U5 Deleting a patient hard-deletes all of that patient's data immediately (removed, not hidden), and the audit log is kept.（UAT TC-24；TFA-92579 AC 2；TFA-94699 AC 4）
  • U11 Each processing run in TC-24 (Save Note, Generate, Regenerate) records which AI model ran and the AI call's own time next to the total. Save Note targets 15 s or less; …（UAT 3.5；UAT 3.9；TFA-94514 AC 7）

测试设计方法：性能（performance） — 量时间，看是不是在要求的秒数里。

Given The reads each case saves right after it ends: S03's timed read after OK, and the diagnostics rows of S01, S02, S06, S07 and S26 (each lane-C case runs as its own fresh account)

When Right after OK in S03 the runner reads the patient's rows; right after each processing case ends it reads diagnostics:list for that case's account (or the audit ai_disclosure rows with provider_ms) and saves both into the case dir

Then At the first read after OK the patient and its list row are gone (no later sweep needed). Each Save Note, Generate and Regenerate has a model, providerMs and durationMs; Save Note is compared with the 15 s target; any run over 30 s with a small providerMs is flagged for review with Vikram.

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：'Immediately' (U5) is Pass/Fail: zero rows at the first read after the mutation returns (S03's timed read). The 3.5 timings are recorded, not Pass/Fail; fn, model and fellBackFrom go into the report (3.9). diagnostics.ts keeps only the last 8 aiCallLog rows per user (LOG_LIMIT), so the read happens right after each case, before anything else runs on that account; …

在哪跑：本地 probes（多端探针）；测试方法 PERF · 性能计时；矩阵里排的车道 浏览器 agent（automated）

S21 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-24.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：本地 — main e02167f，本地栈（local stack, not a deployed build）；run folder runs/2026-10-14-local，lane probes。

测试方法：PERF · 性能计时；辅助：API · 接口（Convex 函数） — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 both 跑；来源：probes。

UAT item: TC-24 Deletions · Section: A5 · Cross-Cutting · Scenario: TC-24/S21

Timing: a patient delete takes effect at once; every processing run after deletes logs model, AI time and total

Tickets: TFA-92579 Home Screen: Patient Chart Card (ready for qa); TFA-94514 Analytics tracking (ready for qa); TFA-94699 Data Retention & Purge (in progress)

本地新 lane probes：probes/results.json 里 status passed-partial → 通过（部分通过（判过的格子都通过，有一部分没跑 / 是模拟的））。

怎么测（probes/plan.json，automatable: yes）：Post-run read probe: remove a patient through the list (confirm), first admin read right after: document and list row gone; one LIVE Save Note, Generate and Regenerate on one Hospital chart, read diagnostics:list after each and all aiCallLog + ai_disclosure rows of the account: model, durationMs, providerMs present; 15 s / 30 s figures recorded, not judged. [Review 2026-10-14] Labelled passed-partial (Generate / Regenerate cells gated); patch carries partial.needs = ['generate']. — backend-read-admin is read-only on the local stack; Generate is allowed locally with bounded live calls (≈8).

Detail:

Partial — 2/2 judged cells pass, Generate / Regenerate NOT RUN. Pass/Fail item (U5): at the first read after the remove returned (472 ms) the document is null and the list row gone. Save Note logged parsePreRoundNotes / extractTasks / classifyAdmissionReason with model (Haiku), durationMs and providerMs, matching ai_disclosure rows; Save Note 9.7 s (≤ 15 s target, record-only). Generate / Regenerate is forbidden on the local target (scripts/capabilities.json, Quinn 2026-10-13); those cells run only with QA_ALLOW_LOCAL_GENERATE=1.

证据：附了 2 个。

Dev run: skipped: local-only — local-only — Its runner (post-run-read) collects S03's timed read (action-timing) and, as the fallback, the audit ai_disclosure rows (backend-read-admin); dev has no admin key, so it stays on the local stack.. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
